name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 74.2 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: Saya butuh 3 tiket untuk besok pagi.
entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.

entries.source: Kami berlima, termasuk 2 anak.
entries.reference: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.

entries.source: Nomor telepon saya adalah 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: Penerbangan memakan waktu 9 jam 25 menit.
entries.reference: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Kami berempat dan membawa 6 koper.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.

entries.source: Kamar 214 ada di lantai dua.
entries.reference: Room 214 is on the second floor.

entries.source: Saya tiba tanggal 3 Oktober dan berangkat tanggal 9 Oktober.
entries.reference: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.

entries.source: Jam berapa museum buka pada hari Minggu?
entries.reference: What time does the museum open on Sundays?

entries.source: Kereta saya berangkat pukul 18:45 dari peron 7.
entries.reference: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: Bus terakhir berangkat pukul 23:30 malam ini.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Saya punya reservasi pukul 8 malam untuk 2 orang.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.

entries.source: Apakah apotek buka sebelum pukul 9 pagi?
entries.reference: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: Tur dimulai pukul 14:15 dan berlangsung 3 jam.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.

entries.source: Sarapan disajikan dari pukul 6:30 sampai 10:00.
entries.reference: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Berapa harga kamar double untuk 3 malam?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?

entries.source: Harganya 45 euro, sudah termasuk pajak.
entries.reference: This costs 45 euros, including tax.

entries.source: Apakah ada diskon untuk 2 dewasa dan 1 anak?
entries.reference: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?

entries.source: Harga tiket 12,50 euro per orang.
entries.reference: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.

entries.source: Bisakah saya membayar 78 euro dengan kartu?
entries.reference: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?

entries.source: Berapa ongkos bus bandara untuk 2 orang?
entries.reference: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: Menu hari ini 15 euro sudah termasuk minuman.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: Alamatnya Calle Mayor 15, lantai tiga.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: Hotel saya di Gran Vía 28, dekat metro.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: Kedutaan berada di Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Tolong catat alamatnya: nomor 42, apartemen 5B.
entries.reference: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: Titik kumpulnya di Plaza del Sol, gerbang 3.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: Apakah ini jalan ke Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Di mana halte bus terdekat?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Belok kiri di lampu lalu lintas, lalu lurus 200 meter.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.

entries.source: Apakah stasiun bisa dicapai dengan berjalan kaki dari hotel?
entries.reference: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Jalur mana yang ke bandara, jalur 5 atau jalur 8?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?

entries.source: Permisi, apakah ini kursi 14A?
entries.reference: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?

entries.source: Bagaimana cara ke kota tua dari sini?
entries.reference: How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: Museum sekitar 15 menit berjalan kaki dari alun-alun.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.

entries.source: Tolong panggil ambulans, ada orang pingsan.
entries.reference: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.

entries.source: Saya kehilangan paspor dan dompet saya.
entries.reference: I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Di mana rumah sakit atau klinik terdekat?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Saya alergi kacang; apakah hidangan ini mengandung kacang?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Seseorang mencuri tas saya berisi 200 euro.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Panggil polisi, tolong. Ada kecelakaan.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
